note: Every portfolio, ticker choice and number is invented; nothing was fetched. Each file's SHA-256 is frozen here; a changed file fails provenance.

clean.c01-tech-crash-semiconductor-heavy: tech_crash on a semiconductor-heavy book; weights sum to exactly 1.0; every ticker in the sector map (CRITICAL)
clean.c02-rate-hike-mixed-book: rate_hike; two mapped big-tech tickers and two invented tickers outside the map, which fall back to tech_sector (MODERATE)
clean.c03-ai-regulation-outside-the-map: ai_regulation on invented tickers the map does not know: only the market shock reaches them (LOW)
clean.c04-chip-shortage-mostly-unmapped: chip_shortage; one mapped semiconductor, two unmapped (HIGH, 29 percent)
clean.c05-black-swan-two-names: black_swan; weights exactly 1.0 (CRITICAL, the market shock alone)
clean.c06-weights-sum-to-six-tenths: weights sum to 0.6, so Validate Portfolio rescales them to 1.0
clean.c07-weights-within-tolerance: weights sum to 1.005: inside the 0.01 tolerance, so nothing is rescaled
clean.c08-weights-sum-to-one-point-two: weights sum to 1.2, so they are rescaled
clean.c09-scenario-type-absent: no scenario_type and no custom scenario: Load_Template_Scenario falls back to tech_crash
clean.c10-custom-scenario-needs-the-llm: custom_scenario set: the workflow routes to the Groq chain, which this contribution never calls (a recorded handoff)
clean.c11-exactly-ten-percent: rate_hike on two big-tech names: drawdown is exactly 10.0 percent, and the engine's rule is 'above 10' (LOW)
clean.c12-growth-stack-rate-hike: rate_hike on four growth names (CRITICAL, 33.75 percent)

d09-empty-holdings.what_the_workflow_does: workflow runs and returns a zero-loss LOW result for nothing

d10-weight-missing.defect: the second holding has no weight and the others sum to 1.0
d10-weight-missing.what_the_workflow_does: Validate Portfolio passes it; the engine fails on the missing weight
